case.title: Happy thank-you note
case.subject: Thank you!
case.text:
Just wanted to say thank you to Sam from your support team for helping me set up deposits last week. No-shows are down a lot already. You've made my life so much easier!

Grace
case.why: Labelled as qualifying: a real customer wrote to us and deserves a short human thank-you. Lowest urgency, no KB needed.

output.reply:
Hi Grace,

Thank you so much for the kind words! We're delighted to hear that deposits are already cutting down your no-shows, and I'll make sure Sam hears your feedback. If you need anything else, just reply to this email.

Best wishes,
The Slotwise Support Team

output.reply:
Hi Grace,

Thank you so much for your kind words! We're delighted to hear that deposits are already cutting down your no-shows and making things easier for you. I'll make sure your feedback gets passed on to Sam.

If you ever want to cut no-shows further, automatic SMS or WhatsApp reminders can help too, and you can find them under Settings → Reminders.

Wishing you a very busy and smooth-running schedule!

Slotwise Support
